state_model.rollback_precondition: state must be applied; proposed returns 409 (somente alteração aplicada pode ser revertida)
state_model.rollback_effect: canonical mutation/version/outbox; therefore inapplicable and forbidden here

operational_decision.corrected_proposal: may coexist through normal POST after correction; unique key includes owner, run, target and proposal_hash, so a changed hash yields a distinct row; same hash is idempotent
operational_decision.canonical_side_effect_of_new_proposed_ro: none (no version, outbox, notification or catalogue mutation until approve/apply)
